enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to the left side. Turn to the right side. Adjust the pillow. Stretch arms. Turn again. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn to the back. Adjust blanket. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Pick up the toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with a towel. Turn off the tap and light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, toasting bread and making tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Open the refrigerator. Take out bread and milk. Place bread in the toaster. Press the toaster lever. Open the cabinet. Take out a plate and cup. Pour milk into the cup. Wait for the toaster. Remove toast from the toaster. Spread butter on the toast. Eat the toast and drink milk.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bedroom. Open the wardrobe. Take out a shirt, pants, and socks. Take off pajamas. Put on the shirt. Put on the pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open the work bag. Put a laptop and water bottle into the bag. Zip the bag. Pick up the bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the health care facility
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the house. Walk to the bus stop. Wait for the bus. Board the bus. Swipe the transit card. Sit down. Check the phone. Get off the bus. Walk to the subway station. Enter the subway station. Swipe the transit card. Walk to the platform. Wait for the train. Board the train. Sit down. Read a book. Get off the train. Walk to the health care facility. Enter the building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, seeing patients and updating clinical records
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the office. Turn on the computer. Log in to the system. Open the patient list. Call the first patient. Escort the patient to the examination room. Measure blood pressure. Check temperature. Ask about symptoms. Update the clinical record. Prescribe medication. Call the next patient. Escort the patient to the examination room. Perform a physical examination. Update the clinical record. Coordinate with a colleague. Attend a team meeting. Review test results. Update the clinical record. Take a break.
Walk to the cafeteria. Pick up a tray. Select food. Pay for the food. Sit at a table. Eat the food. Drink water. Talk with a colleague. Throw away the trash. Return the tray. Walk back to the office.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical duties, patient care and coordinating with colleagues
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the examination room. Wash hands. Put on gloves. Examine a patient. Update the clinical record. Coordinate with a nurse. Attend a meeting. Review a treatment plan. Call a specialist. Update the clinical record. Examine another patient. Administer a vaccine. Update the clinical record. Coordinate with a colleague. Attend a team huddle. Review lab results. Update the clinical record. Clean the examination room.

Walk out of the health care facility. Walk to the subway station. Enter the subway station. Swipe the transit card. Walk to the platform. Wait for the train. Board the train. Sit down. Check the phone. Get off the train. Walk to the bus stop. Wait for the bus. Board the bus. Swipe the transit card. Sit down. Look out the window. Get off the bus. Walk to the house. Enter the house.

Walk into the kitchen. Open the refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Wash the vegetables. Chop the vegetables and meat. Turn on the induction cooker. Place a pan on the cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Add the meat. Stir the meat. Add the vegetables. Stir the vegetables. Add salt. Turn off the induction cooker. Transfer the food to a plate. Sit down. Eat the dinner. Drink water. Clear the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen counters
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the dishes. Scrape food into the trash. Load the dishwasher. Add detergent. Close the dishwasher. Start the dishwasher. Pick up a sponge. Wipe the counters. Wipe the stove. Throw away the trash. Turn off the kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing personal laundry and putting clothes in the dryer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Open the washing machine. Put dirty clothes into the washing machine. Add detergent. Close the washing machine. Start the washing machine. Wait for the wash cycle. Open the washing machine. Take out wet clothes. Put wet clothes into the dryer. Close the dryer. Start the dryer.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa, watching TV and browsing on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Sit on the sofa. Pick up the remote control. Turn on the TV. Change the channel. Put down the remote control. Pick up the laptop. Open the laptop. Browse the internet. Check social media. Watch a TV show. Pick up the remote control. Change the channel. Put down the remote control. Pick up a snack. Eat the snack. Pick up the laptop. Close the laptop. Turn off the TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the shower. Step into the shower. Wash hair. Wash body. Turn off the shower. Pick up a towel. Dry body. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk to the bedroom.

Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to the left side. Turn to the right side. Adjust the pillow. Stretch arms. Turn again. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn to the back. Adjust blanket. Continue sleeping.
